source_assistant: An expert answer should distinguish model-domain mechanisms from runtime measurements. It must report topology, workload, units, baselines, confounders, and evidence needed before claiming improvement.
corrected_answer: Assumptions: pin and verify the deployed NVIDIA Dynamo release, model/tokenizer, software and driver versions, context/output distributions, request mix, concurrency, offered load, batching, cache warmth, GPU/node/NIC topology, RDMA settings, tenant policy, correctness and deadline targets; do not infer unsupported release capabilities. Hypothesis: for corpus-05713, under matched workload, quality, and offered load, disaggregation improves a predeclared target such as p95 TTFT or throughput without breaching p99 ITL, end-to-end p99 latency, timeout/error, correctness, isolation, or cost limits. Define ownership and contracts for frontend admission/routing, queues, scheduler, prefill, decode, KV serialization and transfer, transport, and control plane, including model/layer/shape/dtype/position compatibility, integrity checks, authorization and tenant isolation. Compare co-located serving, a meaningful no-KV-movement ablation, and the complete path with randomized repeated trials stratified by prompt and output length, offered load, warm/cold cache, placement, and link topology. Capture synchronized per-request traces and raw counters with units: admission/queue, prefill/decode compute, KV bytes and transfer time, transport retries, scheduler decisions, GPU/NIC utilization, TTFT, ITL, end-to-end p50/p95/p99, throughput, error/timeout rate, output correctness, and cost. Use read-only diagnostics first and one reversible change at a time. Inject bounded, authorized faults (worker loss, delayed/dropped/corrupt/incompatible KV, RDMA degradation, queue saturation, control-plane loss) in an isolated test window; reject invalid KV, fence stale workers, apply backpressure, drain and retry only within a deadline, and fall back to a safe co-located or reduced-capacity path. Roll back on correctness/security violations, missing observability, error or tail-latency SLO breaches, unsafe isolation, or loss of provenance. Claim improvement only with matched baselines, confidence intervals, repeated trials, predeclared acceptance gates, and raw traces; otherwise mark evidence_required. For tool use, record commands, versions, permissions, timestamps, topology and health snapshots before changing anything; preserve an audit trail and avoid destructive or credential-bearing actions.
